book.name: JUAN
book.title: Tzilaj Jtaquil Chirij Kakaj Jesucristo Ri Xtz'ib'aj Juan

content: Kakaj Jesús tich'a'w riq'ui Kakaj Dios
Cuando xijmaj jilonli jwi'l Kakaj Jesús rechak yak ajtijol rib'ak chirij, xna'tun lecj y xij: Kaj, xtawi' or tanimirsaj jk'ij Ac'ajol pire tinimirsaj ak'ij jwi'l Ac'ajol.
At xatye'w k'atb'itzij laj jk'ab' Ac'ajol chib' juntir cristian pire tijye' jun tzilaj c'aslemal aac'l lecj ri ta' jq'uisic rechak juntir yak ri jachal laj jk'ab' awi'l.

Ri' ri, ri tic'amomb'i li tzilaj c'aslemal lecj ri ta' jq'uisic, rajwaxi' tretemajtak nen tab'an at, ri xike at ri tz'etel Dios y ta' ni jono chic y tretemajtak nen tran Jesucristo ri takalch awi'l wich ulew.
In xinnimirsaji' ak'ij neri wich ulew y xinq'uisa' jb'anic juntir ri xinatakch chi jb'anic.
Lajori, Kaj, nimirsaj ink'ij aac'l chapca' jnimal ink'ij ri wi' cuando ajwini' aac'l cuando ajqui' chi wa'x caj pach ulew.

Y yak ri cha'l awi'l chijxo'lak mak cristian ri retake wich ulew pire xajach laj ink'b', ximb'iji' rechak nen ab'anic at. Rechak laj ak'b'i' wi'tak, pero xak'asaji' laj ink'b' in y lajori xcoja'taka' ayolj.
Lajori retamakchak chi juntir ri xaye' chwe ji' petzal aac'l.
Y ximb'iji' rechak ri xinatakch chi jb'ij y rechak xcoja'taka'n. Xretemajtaka' chi ji' ximpe aac'l y rechak xcoja'taka' chi ati' attakowinakch we.

In tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chirijak, ta' tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chirijak mak cristian ri retake wich ulew. In tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chirijak yak ri cha'l awi'l ri wi'tak laj ink'b' jwi'l awechi'n.
Juntir ri we in, awechi' at y juntir ri awe at, wechi' in y yak cristian li xnimirsajtaka' ink'ij.

In ta' chiqui' naj inwa'x neri wich ulew, pero rechak tina cantakna wich ulew y in inelb'i neri pire imb'e wa'xok aac'l. At Lok'laj Inkaj, la' acwinel chajaj yak ri jachal laj ink'b' awi'l pire trantak junke jwichak chapca' in aac'l ojke jun.

In cuando win riq'uilak neri wich ulew, xinchajajtaka' la' acwinel juntir yak ri jachal laj ink'b' awi'l y xincola'taka'n, ni jono rechak xsaachtak. Pero xike jun ri tina saachna chijxo'lak jwi'l tina tawna chiwch ri tijb'ij li wuj re Lok'laj Ayolj.
Lajori inchak b'e lamas watwi' at, pero jwi'l ajwinna chijxo'lak neri wich ulew tamb'ij juntir ri pire tiwa'x sub'laj qui'cotemal laj ranmak jilon chapca' ri wi' laj wanm in.
In ximb'iji' ri xinatakch chi jb'ij rechak, pero mak cristian ri retake wich ulew tijcontrijtaka' rechak jwi'l rechak ma' retak ta' wich ulew chapca' in ma' in ta' re wich ulew.
In ta' tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chi tawesajtakb'i neri wich ulew, in tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chi tacoltak laj jk'ab' man jb'ab'al etzl.
Rechak ma' retak ta' wich ulew jilon chapca' in, ma' in ta' re wich ulew.
Tostak pi awe la' atzij pire trantak lawi' chawaj trantak, atzij tz'etel tz'eti'n.
Chapca' intakicch in xab'an chijxo'lak mak cristian ri retake wich ulew, jilon jtakicak rechak tamb'an chicb'i in chijxo'lak mak cristian ri retake wich ulew.
Y jwi'l rechak tanjach wib' laj ak'b' pire kes tz'etel tz'et titosmajtak pi awe.
Pero ma' xita'ke chirijak yak ajtijol rib'ak chwij ri, tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe, jilon chirijak yak ri tina cub'arna jch'olak chwij nen or jwi'l ri tijb'ijtak rechak.

In tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chirijak juntir rib'ilak pire tiwuxtak jun kiq'uil chapca' in aac'l ojke jun jwi'l wati' laj wanm y in wini' laj awanm. Y tantz'onaj tok'ob' chawe chi tiwuxtak junke jwichak pire tretemajtak mak cristian ri retake wich ulew chi ati' attakowinakch we.
In xinnimirsaji' jk'ij rechak chapca' jnimal ink'ij in pire tiwuxtak junke jwichak chapca' in aac'l ojke jun.

In inwa'xi' laj ranmak rechak y at wati' laj wanm pire tiwuxtak chapca' juntake chi cristian, jilonli juntir mak cristian ri retake wich ulew tretemajtak chi ati' attakowinakch we y talok'ajtaka' rechak chapca' inlok'aj in tab'an.

Kaj, at xatjachow rechak laj ink'b' y ri' chwaj tiwa'xtak rechak wiq'uil lamas imb'e wa'xok in, pire triltak jnimal ink'ij ri ye'l awi'l jwi'l lok'alquinchakch awi'l cuando ajqui' chi wa'x caj pach ulew.

Kaj, ri atb'anow juntir ri kes pi jcholajl, mak cristian ri retake wich ulew ta' tretemajtak nen tab'an. Pero in wetami' nen tab'an y yak ri jachal laj ink'b' awi'l retamakchak chi ati' attakowinakch we.
Xinya' retemaj rechak nen ab'anic at y tina imb'ijna chic rechak pire tilok'intak chapca' inlok'aj in tab'an y pire inwa'x laj ranmak, xche' Kakaj Jesús re Kakaj Dios.
